title: /kb-sprint close removes the sprint's worktrees and work branches
goal: The /kb-sprint close step, after the close commit is pushed, removes each subagent worktree under .claude/worktrees and each local work/<id> and worktree-agent-* branch of the sprint's items: it first runs `git cherry main <branch>` and removes only a branch whose every commit is on main (no '+' line), then `git worktree remove` (without --force, so a worktree with uncommitted files is kept and reported) and `git branch -D` (a branch landed by cherry-pick is not an ancestor of main, so -d refuses it); it never touches a locked worktree, another sprint's branch or _cache/querylog/worktree, and reports each one it kept and why; the skill names these commands. Answers the SP-fkyrld5h failure: leftover sprint worktrees made test_research_merge fail in the full tests.py (BG-rrht7uts) and dozens of stale worktrees and work branches from past sprints remained in the clone.
